about: MCP JSON-RPC messages as coder mcp receives them on stdio, one a line. coder/tui/mcp.coax is the only file that parses them (cd_mcp_answer); what comes out is the reply line Coder writes, or no line for a response or a notification. The bytes are the specification's own published examples, as the repository already held them in psionic/tests/harness-protocols-fixtures.coax (PR_FX_SPEC_*; Coder book chapter 16, Independent checks). `want.reply` is the whole line cd_mcp_answer gives: Coder has no get_weather tool, so the specification's call gets JSON-RPC error -32602 under the request's id; a response gets no answer. Not here yet: an initialize, a tools/list and a tools/call for one of Coder's own tools as a real client (Claude Code, Codex) sends them; no such recording is in the repository. Checked by coder/tui/mcp-external-checks.coax, which holds the same bytes as constants (a Coax test reads no file).
